note:
R15 — Players (PS4 15–21): the head / hair asset binding through the Attrib/VLT vault, decoded to attribute level with the R7
reader. `ge_nhl_skaterhead` and `ge_nhl_skaterheadtexturepack` records carry an enum attribute of type `SkaterNameAttribute` (key
0x4028769e, name not resolved) whose value is the database `exhibitionplayerbiotable.headid`; `ge_nhl_skaterhairtexturepack` carries
`GenericHairStyle` (0x9def4631) = the database `hairid`. Per title: coverage of every DB headid / hairid by the vault values, bespoke
head name agreement with the player's name (slug heuristic, mismatches listed), artid == headid count, referenced texture paths for a
few witnesses. Read-only. Usage: python r15_player_asset_binding.py <out.json>
